title: 8，沈飞能忍，但不是不敢杀人!
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

用了将近半个小时，猫耳洞终于被清了出来。

沈飞和穆萨把工兵铲靠在壕壁旁，回到自己的背包边上。

两人都累得不轻。

穆萨胸膛剧烈起伏，肩膀上全是泥，整个人像是刚从沼泽里爬出来的黑熊。

沈飞也没好到哪去，指尖冻得发麻，双手连握枪都在颤抖。

四周很安静，

只有头顶漆黑的天空里，隐约传来像是蚊子在耳边的嗡嗡的无人机声音。

穆萨低头看了一眼工兵铲，忍不住压着嗓子骂道，“该死的，这地方的黑土地有病吗，看起来是浮土，挖起来跟石头一样。”

“我以前在港口搬铁块，都没这么累。”

能不难挖吗？

泥土里混着碎砖、弹片、木屑、弹壳、破布，还有一些已经腐烂到分不清来源的东西。

炮弹把土地炸开。

雨水把它泡软。

军靴和下一轮炮击又把它重新压实。

几十遍。

最后这片黑土地就变成了一种说不清的东西。

沈飞不知道这种土的准确叫法，但他明白现在其实还不算糟糕。

等再过一段时间，气温继续下降，这些土彻底冻住，那才是真正的噩梦。

到时候别说挖猫耳洞。

恐怕想往地里多刨出十厘米，都得拿命换。

系统奖励还没来。

但危机感已经又增加了许多。

就在这时，穆萨蹲下身，伸手去翻自己的背包，然后他皱眉说道，“该死的......”

“我背包里的袜子呢？”

沈飞几乎是下意识

背包被翻过，里面的东西乱了。

水壶还在。

罐头还在。

胶带也在。

唯独两双干袜子没了。

如果是在其他地方，丢两双袜子不算什么，可在泥泞的堑壕里，干袜子不是生活用品，而是他们的半条命。

在来防线的路上，沈飞亲眼见过那些脚掌泡烂的士兵，他们蜷缩在壕壁旁边，眼神麻木，脚上散发着恶臭的腐烂伤口。

那种人如果遇到撤退，根本走不了。

走不了，

就只能被留下。

被留下，在这里基本等于死。

穆萨猛地站起身，压着火气问道，“谁拿了我们的袜子？”

壕沟里的人都看了过来。

伊万第一个咧嘴笑了：“废物，自己的东西都看不好，那是你自己的责任。”

穆萨嘴角抽搐，一把操起放在堑壕旁的工兵铲：“该死的....混蛋东西....把我的袜子还给我!”

“苏卡不列，谁会稀罕黑鬼的袜子？”伊万比他更凶，混不吝的说：“你他妈喊什么，想把二毛的无人机引过来？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After nearly half an hour, the cat ear hole was finally removed.

Shen Fei and Musa leaned the engineer shovel against the trench wall and returned to their backpacks.

Both of them were very tired.

Musa's chest heaved violently, his shoulders were covered with mud, and his whole figure looked like a black bear that had just crawled out of the swamp.

Shen Fei was not much better, his fingertips were numb from the cold, and his hands were shaking even when holding the gun.

It's quiet all around,

Only the drone sound like the buzzing of mosquitoes in the ears could be heard faintly in the dark sky above.

Musa lowered his head and glanced at the engineer's shovel, and couldn't help but curse in a low voice, "Damn it, is there something wrong with the black soil here? It looks like loose soil, and it looks like stone when dug."

"I've never been this tired before moving iron blocks at the port."

Isn’t it difficult to dig?

The soil was mixed with broken bricks, shrapnel, sawdust, bullet casings, rags, and some things that were so rotten that their origins could not be identified.

Shells blasted the land apart.

The rain softened it.

Army boots and the next round of shelling compacted it again.

Dozens of times.

In the end, this black land turned into something indescribable.

Shen Fei didn't know the exact name of this kind of soil, but he understood that it wasn't actually that bad now.

After a while, the temperature continues to drop and the soil freezes completely, which will be a real nightmare.

Don't talk about piercing the cat's ears then.

I'm afraid if you want to dig out ten centimeters more into the ground, you will have to pay for it with your life.

The system reward has not come yet.

But the sense of crisis has increased a lot.

At this moment, Musa squatted down, reached for his backpack, and then he frowned and said, "Damn..."

“Where are the socks in my backpack?”

Shen Fei almost subconsciously

The backpack had been turned over and its contents were disorganized.

The kettle is still there.

The cans are still there.

The tape is there too.

Only two pairs of dry socks were missing.

In other places, losing two pairs of socks is nothing, but in the muddy trench, dry socks are not daily necessities, but half their lives.

On the way to the defense line, Shen Fei saw with his own eyes the soldiers with soaked soles of their feet. They were huddled next to the trench wall, their eyes were numb, and there were rotten wounds on their feet that exuded a foul odor.

That kind of person won't be able to leave if he encounters a retreat.

Can't leave,

It can only be left behind.

Being left here is basically equivalent to death.

Musa stood up suddenly and asked, "Who took our socks?"

Everyone in the trench looked over.

Ivan was the first to grin: "Trash, you don't care about your own things. That's your own responsibility."

The corner of Musa's mouth twitched, and he picked up the engineer shovel placed next to the trench: "Damn... you bastard... give me back my socks!"

"Suka, who cares about a nigger's socks?" Ivan was even more fierce than him, and he said unhesitatingly: "What the hell are you shouting to attract Er Mao's drone?"
